scope: Entire staged versions of new and modified files; escaped PEM markers are also matched by header text
manual_review: Generated private keys, passwords, tokens, runtime signatures, .env and local caches/artifacts excluded from index
Public issuer/JWKS, certificate names, source hashes and fixture-only invalid credentials are not production secrets
Application auth/TLS/order-policy paths and approved migrations unchanged; only requested hardening staged
limitations: Pattern and manual review, not a comprehensive entropy/history audit or proof of absence of every possible secret. Tests generate secrets at runtime; their source code is not secret material.
